## Overview On ROCm, run decode-only batches of Gated-DeltaNet layers (Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5-family) through AITER's fused conv1d + delta-rule + gated-RMSNorm gluon kernel instead of three kernels. Requires the `qkvz_layout`, `query_start_loc` and `out` arguments of `fused_gdn_decode_qkvz`, which were added by [ROCm/aiter#6488](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6488) in AITER release v0.1.27. Without them, the layer keeps the unfused path. A bf16 recurrent state (`--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`) also needs [ROCm/aiter#6884](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6884), which is now merged in AITER main. With [ROCm/aiter#6488](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6488) but not [ROCm/aiter#6884](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6884), a bf16-state server fails on its first fused decode with AITER's `ValueError`. ## Claims - One launch per GDN layer per decode step instead of three (conv1d, recurrence, gated norm): 882 → 730 kernels/step. - Qwen3.8-27B BF16 TP1 on MI355X, 1024×1024, concurrency 16–64: **+2.2–3.1% total tok/s, −2.3–2.8% mean TPOT**, TTFT unchanged. Per GDN layer at 64 tokens: 91 → 73 µs. - With a bf16 recurrent state the fused kernel moves half the state bytes: **+7.7% total tok/s, −8.0% mean TPOT** at c64 versus the fp32 state. GSM8K and GPQA Diamond unchanged from fp32 to bf16. - GSM8K unchanged from main. Prefill, mixed and speculative batches, CUDA/XPU, quantized models: no behaviour change. ## Validation ### fp32 recurrent state A/B on one MI355X in the `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` image of 2026-10-05 (vLLM 92044241a0, aiter 0.1.24.post1 + [ROCm/aiter#5520](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/5520) + [ROCm/aiter#6488](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6488)), 1024×1024 random prompts, 10 × concurrency requests: | Concurrency | Total tok/s Main → PR | Mean TPOT (ms) Main → PR | Mean TTFT (ms) Main → PR | |--|--|--|--| | 16 | 1919.5 → 1978.7 (+3.1%) | 16.10 → 15.65 (−2.8%) | 595.6 → 543.3 (−8.8%) | | 32 | 3338.5 → 3413.3 (+2.2%) | 18.37 → 17.95 (−2.3%) | 829.2 → 831.8 (+0.3%) | | 64 | 5602.0 → 5748.1 (+2.6%) | 21.84 → 21.26 (−2.7%) | 1048.3 → 1048.1 (−0.0%) | Per-layer decode kernels, 64-token steps (torch profiler, 1024×64): Before: After: GSM8K (lm_eval local-completions, 5-shot, n = 1319): | | flexible | strict | |--|--|--| | main | 0.7263 | 0.7028 | | PR | 0.7278 | 0.7013 | GPQA Diamond (lm_eval local-chat-completions, thinking mode, n = 198), flexible-extract: | | accuracy | |--|--| | main | 0.7980 | | PR, fp32 | 0.7626 | Reproduction: ``` # Serve VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --tensor-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 262144 \ --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --language-model-only --no-enable-prefix-caching --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \ --async-scheduling -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True # Bench (shown for c64; --num-prompts = 10 × --max-concurrency) vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency 64 --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 # GSM8K lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --seed 1234 \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False # GPQA Diamond (serve as above plus --reasoning-parser qwen3) lm_eval --model local-chat-completions --apply_chat_template --tasks gpqa_diamond_cot_zeroshot --num_fewshot 0 \ --seed 1234 --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=229376,temperature=1.0,top_p=0.95,top_k=20 \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False ``` ### fp32 recurrent state, 8K input | Concurrency | Total tok/s Main → PR | Mean TPOT (ms) Main → PR | Mean TTFT (ms) Main → PR | |--|--|--|--| | 16 | 3707.3 → 3761.9 (+1.5%) | 35.78 → 35.20 (−1.6%) | 3154.3 → 3164.0 (+0.3%) | | 32 | 5667.9 → 5691.8 (+0.4%) | 47.07 → 46.84 (−0.5%) | 3833.6 → 3852.0 (+0.5%) | | 64 | 8539.4 → 8545.0 (+0.1%) | 62.70 → 62.67 (−0.0%) | 4836.2 → 4819.7 (−0.3%) | Reproduction: Serve as above. Bench with `--random-input-len 8192`. ### bf16 recurrent state A/B on one MI355X in the `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` image of 2026-10-05 (vLLM 92044241a0, aiter 0.1.24.post1 + [ROCm/aiter#5520](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/5520) + [ROCm/aiter#6488](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6488) + [ROCm/aiter#6884](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6884)), 1024×1024 random prompts, 10 × concurrency requests. Both arms run this PR stack; only `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` differs (`float32` vs `bfloat16`). | Concurrency | Total tok/s fp32 → bf16 | Mean TPOT (ms) fp32 → bf16 | Mean TTFT (ms) fp32 → bf16 | |--|--|--|--| | 16 | 1954.6 → 2005.6 (+2.6%) | 15.81 → 15.39 (−2.7%) | 592.1 → 593.8 (+0.3%) | | 32 | 3360.6 → 3533.3 (+5.1%) | 18.29 → 17.18 (−6.1%) | 779.9 → 968.1 (+24.1%) | | 64 | 5631.7 → 6063.7 (+7.7%) | 21.58 → 19.85 (−8.0%) | 1184.4 → 1298.4 (+9.6%) | GSM8K (lm_eval local-completions, 5-shot, n = 1319): | | flexible | strict | |--|--|--| | fp32 | 0.7278 | 0.7013 | | bf16 | 0.7255 | 0.7043 | GPQA Diamond (lm_eval local-chat-completions, thinking mode, n = 198), flexible-extract: | | accuracy | |--|--| | PR, fp32 | 0.7626 | | PR, bf16 | 0.7778 | Reproduction: ``` # Serve (bf16 arm; drop --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype for the fp32 arm) VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --tensor-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 262144 \ --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --language-model-only --no-enable-prefix-caching --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \ --async-scheduling -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 # Bench (shown for c64; --num-prompts = 10 × --max-concurrency) vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency 64 --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 # GSM8K lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --seed 1234 \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False # GPQA Diamond (serve as above plus --reasoning-parser qwen3; drop --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype for the fp32 arm) lm_eval --model local-chat-completions --apply_chat_template --tasks gpqa_diamond_cot_zeroshot --num_fewshot 0 \ --seed 1234 --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=229376,temperature=1.0,top_p=0.95,top_k=20 \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False ``` ## Details - `qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py`: on ROCm, `forward_hip` calls a new custom op `qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_rocm(qkvz, ba, normed_out)` that writes the gated-normed output straight into the `out_proj` input buffer. Decode-only batches (no prefill, no spec) run the fused kernel. Other batches run the unfused path in `_forward_core_rocm`, then the layer's gated norm over the real tokens, so prefill/mixed/spec behaviour is unchanged. - Enablement follows the existing CUDA fused-decode gate (`_fused_gdn_decode_unsupported_reason`): an init-time `_aiter_fused_gdn_decode_unsupported_reason` requires a bf16 model with K = V = 128, 2 or 3 value heads per key head, conv width 4, SiLU conv and gate activations, a bf16 conv cache and a recurrent state in `FUSED_GDN_STATE_DTYPES` (fp32 or bf16, the same set the CUDA gate uses), plus an unquantized `out_proj` (the kernel emits the normed output, so the norm cannot be fused with an `out_proj` input quantization). Unsupported layers log once and keep the current path. No new environment variable: `rocm_aiter_ops.is_fused_gdn_decode_enabled` (`_aiter_ops.py`) turns the kernel on when `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, the GPU is gfx950 and the installed AITER's `fused_gdn_decode_qkvz` has [ROCm/aiter#6488](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6488)'s arguments. ---

--num-prompts = 10 × --max-concurrency) vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency 64 --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 # GSM8K lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --seed 1234 \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False # GPQA Diamond (serve as above plus --reasoning-parser qwen3; drop --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype for the fp32 arm) lm_eval --model local-chat-completions --apply_chat_template --tasks gpqa_diamond_cot_zeroshot --num_fewshot 0 \ --seed 1234 --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=229376,temperature=1.0,top_p=0.95,top_k=20 \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False ``` ## Details - `qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py`: on ROCm, `forward_hip` calls a new custom op `qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_rocm(qkvz, ba, normed_out)` that writes the gated-normed output straight into the `out_proj` input buffer. Decode-only batches (no prefill, no spec) run the fused kernel. Other batches run the unfused path in `_forward_core_rocm`, then the layer's gated norm over the real tokens, so prefill/mixed/spec behaviour is unchanged. - Enablement follows the existing CUDA fused-decode gate (`_fused_gdn_decode_unsupported_reason`): an init-time `_aiter_fused_gdn_decode_unsupported_reason` requires a bf16 model with K = V = 128, 2 or 3 value heads per key head, conv width 4, SiLU conv and gate activations, a bf16 conv cache and a recurrent state in `FUSED_GDN_STATE_DTYPES` (fp32 or bf16, the same set the CUDA gate uses), plus an unquantized `out_proj` (the kernel emits the normed output, so the norm cannot be fused with an `out_proj` input quantization). Unsupported layers log once and keep the current path. No new environment variable: `rocm_aiter_ops.is_fused_gdn_decode_enabled` (`_aiter_ops.py`) turns the kernel on when `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, the GPU is gfx950 and the installed AITER's `fused_gdn_decode_qkvz` has [ROCm/aiter#6488](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6488)'s arguments. ---
